scope: All 302 Unlimited and 306 Revised scans tested. Alpha/Beta retain their prior outer-strip poses. No renderer geometry, artwork or wording is used to choose these poses.
method: Fixed eight-card calibration cohorts per material. Choose a texture medoid from calibration-to-calibration independent selection bands; aggregate supported aligned calibration gradients over three fixed rounds. Recenter to the median calibration pose. Fit translation/uniform scale, admit rotation or affine skew only when separate selection bands improve. A third texture band group accepts/rejects; it never selects a preferred pose. Actual raster replay uses raw-to-canonical resize followed by one composed affine warp.
grouping: Reviewed visible frame material is distinct from semantic card color. Revised Serendib Efreet uses its green frame group, retaining blue card color and mana.
validationDisclosure: Previously seen validation cards remain reused validation. The first trial exposed a four-pixel search-limit failure and the visible-frame grouping bug. The corrected trial reruns the same fixed cohorts; it is not a fresh holdout. No acceptance threshold was lowered. Synthetic poses verify translation, scale, rotation and skew independently of natural-scan metrics.
metrics: Texture values are normalized-gradient correlations, not accuracy percentages. Independent art/rules-edge offsets measure scan-to-scan dispersion against frozen calibration medians, not renderer accuracy. Edge summary eligibility is fixed by baseline edge support; all recorded regressions remain visible.
limits: Texture registration does not prove that every printed component occupies one rigid frame. Cards with multiple rules-box edges more than 0.75 px from the calibration target are retained as explicit interior review cases; this can reflect real printing variation or a measurement error.

Unlimited red/artifact texture groups lack calibration support. Blue and green also retain individual confidence failures. Do not substitute outer-strip acceptance for interior acceptance on those cards.

Whole-card borders must remain measurable using available scan coverage. The comparison-only pose can move the outer boundary; synthetic pixels beyond the source are unavailable, not a match or mismatch.
Original wording/type coverage remains incomplete. No full-card score generation or new renderer release is claimed by this report.
